mapper.select: SELECT favorite_id, user_id, item_id, folder_id, item_name, item_type, create_dt FROM tb_pdf_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN item_type = 'folder' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, item_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_pdf_favorite ( user_id, item_id, folder_id, item_name, item_type ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{id}, #{folderId}, #{name}, #{type} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE folder_id = VALUES(folder_id), item_name = VALUES(item_name), item_type = VALUES(item_type)
